Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Balances Island Sanctuary resource stocks by switching between imported Visland routes. Supports ground and flying filters, target completion, and configurable surplus export for cowries. Open with /stockmanager or /sm.
Changelog: Added the /sm command alias and refreshed the Dalamud plugin description.
